description: Machine-readable SMELTER system requirements. tools/setup reads this file for the requirements scan, setup profiles and the approved winget queue. REQUIREMENTS.md explains it.

npm.purpose: Node package manager, installed with Node.js

wsl.purpose: Windows Subsystem for Linux 2, required by Docker Desktop on Windows
wsl.manual: Run 'wsl --install' in an administrator PowerShell, then restart Windows.

docker.purpose: No-network containers for managed OpenCode, frontend tests/preview and coding workspace tests
docker.manual: Install Docker Desktop with the WSL 2 backend, start it once and accept its terms.

ollama.purpose: Local model runtime for direct chat and OpenCode

opencode.purpose: Native OpenCode CLI; the dashboard agent route uses a container image instead
opencode.manual: Build the pinned OpenCode 1.19.3 image as described in tools/dashboard/OPENCODE_RUNTIME.md.

blender.purpose: 3D asset conversion, scene and animation automation

mcp_sdk.purpose: Built-in MCP tools and the OpenCode bridge

ollama_model.purpose: Reasoning model for chat and OpenCode, chosen from GPU memory by defaults.hardware_profiles. The full smoke test expects qwen3.5:9b

wsl_platform.purpose: Virtual Machine Platform enabled and active, firmware virtualization on. winget's Microsoft.WSL does not enable it; 'wsl --install --no-distribution' does, followed by a Windows restart

image_python.purpose: Confined Python tests in the coding workspace

image_node.purpose: Confined Node tests, CSS validation/preview and the OpenCode image base

image_opencode.purpose: Managed OpenCode agent container; select its sha256 ID in Settings > Confined execution

glb_viewer.purpose: Interactive GLB preview and PNG capture in the dashboard

rea.purpose: Pinned REA static analysis package; needs Node 22.19+, 24.11+ or 26+. Ghidra tools use SMELTER's fixed headless adapter

rea_skill.purpose: Install the matching pinned REA instructions with SMELTER's supported-tool contract; enable only with --enable

melty_kit.purpose: Verified isolated Melty modding kit instructions; installation does not establish an authenticated MCP connection or execute kit code

qwen35b_model.purpose: Explicit 35B-A3B reasoning-model choice; about 22 GB quantized weights, partial CPU/RAM offload on a 16 GB GPU. Does not change saved model settings

ghidra.purpose: Ghidra headless analysis for the tools/bootstraps binary-analysis scripts. Downloads the latest official release, verifies its SHA-256, installs to C:/Tools/Ghidra and sets user JAVA_HOME, GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR and REA_ANALYSIS_PROVIDER

playwright.purpose: Browser automation for the full smoke test

chromium.purpose: Chromium for the full smoke test's GUI and GLB checks

host_credentials: explicit reference to existing Melty-created Codex integration

defaults.description: First-run dashboard values written by tools/setup/configure_defaults.py to .smelter/deployment-defaults.json. The dashboard uses them only for settings that were never saved.

hardware_profiles.label: Powerful GPU, more than 6 GB up to 16 GB
GPU over 16 GB with at least 32 GB RAM
hardware_profiles.note: 20.6 GB mixture-of-experts model (about 3B active); layers that do not fit in VRAM run from system RAM

defaults.custom_profile_note: configure_defaults.py --profile custom seeds extensions, images and storage but leaves the model and runtime for the user to define in the dashboard
defaults.versions_note: Host runtimes checked for drift. OpenCode is pinned inside the smelter-opencode image (1.19.3) and verified by Check managed OpenCode; the native CLI is not used by the dashboard

local_ai.label: Local AI
local_ai.description: Local model runtime, model and built-in MCP tools

opencode_agent.label: OpenCode Agent
opencode_agent.description: Managed OpenCode and confined tests in no-network containers

media.label: Media & GLB
media.description: GLB preview, Blender, media and archive tools

reverse_engineering.label: Reverse Engineering
reverse_engineering.description: Pinned REA instructions, static adapter, fixed headless Ghidra tools and JDK 21

qwen35b_agent.label: Qwen 35B OpenCode Agent
qwen35b_agent.description: Explicit Qwen3.5 35B-A3B plus managed OpenCode and REA/Ghidra; benchmark 16K context before increasing it

melty.label: Melty modding kit
melty.description: Pinned Melty kit; authenticated service connection requires Melty-issued endpoint/auth instructions
